name: Patient inflammation data and analysis code (python-intermediate-inflammation, Binder-ready fork)
description: Synthetic daily inflammation measurements for patients in an imaginary hospital (CSV files in data/), together with the Python package and script that compute and plot the daily mean, maximum and minimum. This fork of carpentries-incubator/python-intermediate-inflammation adds pinned dependencies (requirements.txt, runtime.txt) so that it runs on myBinder, and a notebook (inflammation-analysis.ipynb) that records the analysis outputs.
